en.why_it_matters: This is a memorial birthday night for the vocalist who carried Charlie Parker's bebop language into an unmistakably personal scat vocabulary and helped define the exposed intimacy of voice with bass. The interest is not a generic salute: it is hearing Jordan's New York community answer the space, risk and melodic freedom she made central to vocal jazz after her 2025 death.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York evening is already available, this is a meaningful Dizzy's option. I would wait for the honoring artists to be announced before letting it shape a dedicated corridor trip.

es.why_it_matters: Es una noche de cumpleaños y memoria para la vocalista que llevó el lenguaje bebop de Charlie Parker a un scat inconfundiblemente propio y ayudó a definir la intimidad expuesta de voz con contrabajo. El interés no es un homenaje genérico: es escuchar cómo su comunidad neoyorquina responde al espacio, el riesgo y la libertad melódica que Jordan puso en el centro del jazz vocal después de su muerte en 2025.
es.trip_verdict: Si ya hay una noche disponible en Nueva York, es una opción significativa en Dizzy's. Esperaría el anuncio de los artistas participantes antes de dejar que dicte un viaje regional dedicado.

events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents the Lou Donaldson Centennial Celebration at Dizzy's Club on Monday, November 9, 2026, with sets at 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM. The announced quintet is Champian Fulton on vocals and piano, Jaleel Shaw on alto saxophone, Peter Bernstein on guitar, John Webber on bass and Fukushi Tainaka on drums. Jazz at Lincoln Center frames the evening as a centennial tribute by longtime collaborators and friends to Donaldson's blues-drenched alto sound across bebop, hard bop and soul jazz. The National Endowment for the Arts confirms Donaldson's 2013 Jazz Master fellowship and his role in the early hard-bop and organ-saxophone groove traditions.

That makes the date a lived handoff of hard bop and soul-jazz language rather than a museum recital.

Así, la fecha funciona como relevo vivo del hard bop y el soul jazz, no como recital de museo.
